instructions.name: apply_guardian_config_from_governance
docs: CPI-only from `nave_governance::execute_permission_proposal`. Applies
wallets+threshold bound to a Passed Permission proposal payload.

instructions.name: cancel_guardian_action
docs: Founder-callable: close a finished or stale `GuardianAction` PDA and
reclaim its rent. See `cancel_guardian_action_handler` for the staleness
gate that preserves guardian fail-closed behavior.

accounts.name: guardian_action
docs: The guardian action PDA being closed. Passed by address; its `dao` field
is verified against `dao_registry` in the handler so a founder can only
close their own DAO's actions. Rent is refunded to `authority`.

instructions.name: collect_management_fee
docs: Retained instruction. Transfers nothing and does not advance the
management-fee anchor. Writes the canonical 0 management / 1500
performance bps pair (normal and frozen) when the stored rates differ.
The performance fee is not a standalone instruction. It is a
15%-of-realized-yield skim taken inline on `record_strategy_withdrawal`.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Mint of the registered treasury asset being charged; keys the per-asset
accounts below.

accounts.name: asset_vault
docs: The asset's idle holding account (`asset_vault` PDA, vault_authority-owned)
— the source the in-kind fee is paid from.

accounts.name: revenue_token_account
docs: Destination: protocol revenue wallet's token account for this mint.

instructions.name: configure_marginfi_position
docs: Founder-gated: bind the approved MarginFi group + bank to a position and
(once per DAO) provision its shared cross-margin `MarginfiAccount` ledger
via the real `marginfi_account_initialize_pda` CPI.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Asset mint this position deploys (keys the per-mint `StrategyPosition`
even though the underlying MarginFi ledger is shared across mints).

accounts.name: marginfi_group
docs: the handler, internal layout validated by the marginfi program.

accounts.name: marginfi_account
docs: The DAO's single cross-margin ledger. Not a PDA — MarginFi's classic
`marginfi_account_initialize` (used for maximum compatibility across
marginfi-v2 deployments; see discriminator comment above) requires a
FRESH keypair that co-signs this call and becomes the permanent ledger
address, recorded into `strategy_position.position_token_account`.
Must be empty (uninitialized) the first time; idempotent thereafter.

instructions.name: configure_position_targets
docs: Founder-gated: bind the approved Kamino market + reserve to a position and
provision its vault-owned receipt-token (cToken) account.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Asset mint the position deploys (= reserve liquidity mint).

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: Reserve cToken (collateral) mint that the receipt account will hold.

accounts.name: position_token_account
docs: Vault-owned receipt-token account holding cTokens for this position.

instructions.name: deposit_sol
docs: Deposit native SOL into the DAO's vault authority PDA (native-SOL custody
for governance transfers). Resets NAV staleness so caps re-check against a
fresh revaluation.

accounts.name: treasury_vault
docs: Mutated to reset last_revalued_at after the inbound deposit so the next
deploy/strategy enforces a fresh NAV.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Mint of the deposited asset; keys the `asset_config` used to confirm the
asset is a registered stablecoin and to scale base units to micro-USD.

instructions.name: execute_governance_transfer_native_sol
docs: Native SOL disbursement for a passed `ProposalType::Transfer` vote.
CPI-only: the current instruction must be `nave_governance` (see
`verify_governance_caller`).

accounts.name: treasury_vault
docs: Mutated to reset last_revalued_at after the outbound transfer so the
next deploy/strategy enforces a fresh NAV.

instructions.name: execute_governance_transfer_nft
docs: NFT (ERC-721-equivalent SPL: decimals 0, supply 1) disbursement for a
passed `ProposalType::Transfer` vote whose payload binds (recipient, mint, 1).

instructions.name: execute_governance_transfer_spl
docs: SPL disbursement for a passed `ProposalType::Transfer` vote.
CPI-only from `nave_governance`.

accounts.name: treasury_vault
docs: Mutated to reset last_revalued_at after the outbound transfer so the
next deploy/strategy enforces a fresh NAV.

instructions.name: execute_moonlight_distribution
docs: Distribution wizard step 2: after the bound `MoonlightDistribution`
proposal passes, release an already-locked NAVE stake to the approved
recipient. Pass the nave_core program id for `dao_stake_lock`,
`stake_escrow`, and `recipient_nave_account` when this treasury never
created a DaoStakeLock; distribution still completes.

instructions.name: finalize_moonlight
docs: Final phase: mark the DAO moonlighted/hidden from participants.

accounts.name: agent_set
docs: Agents stay disabled on the moonlighted DAO: flip the real gate here.

accounts.name: treasury_asset
docs: Registered treasury asset whose mint this escrow holds.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Asset mint this position deploys; part of the position PDA seeds.

instructions.name: jito_deposit
docs: Operational-agent-gated: unwrap escrowed wSOL and `DepositSol` into the
configured SPL stake pool, receiving pool tokens into the position account.

accounts.name: sol_funding
docs: Native SOL funding PDA: system-owned, signs `DepositSol`.

accounts.name: temp_wsol
docs: Ephemeral wSOL account used purely to unwrap escrow wSOL into the funding
PDA; created here and closed within the same instruction. Uses
`init_if_needed` (rather than `init`) so a prior deposit that failed
AFTER creating this PDA but BEFORE closing it cannot permanently brick
jito deposits by leaving a stranded account at this address. The handler
additionally asserts the (re)used account is empty before depositing.

instructions.name: jito_withdraw
docs: Operational-agent-gated: `WithdrawSol` from the stake pool and re-wrap the
redeemed lamports into the wSOL escrow.

instructions.name: jupiter_deposit
docs: Operational-agent-gated: supply escrowed liquidity into the Jupiter Lend
Earn vault, minting jlTokens into the vault-owned jlToken ATA.

accounts.name: constitution
docs: SOL-H3: supplies the agent operating threshold for the deploy gate.

accounts.name: treasury_vault
docs: SOL-H3: supplies the NAV freshness marker + current NAV for the deploy gate.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Underlying asset mint being supplied (e.g. wSOL / USDC).

accounts.name: f_token_mint
docs: jlToken (fToken) mint minted by the Jupiter Lend vault for this asset.

accounts.name: depositor_token_account
docs: Vault-owned underlying ATA (deposit source).

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: Vault-owned jlToken ATA (deposit destination).

instructions.name: jupiter_swap
docs: Operational-agent-gated: swap one treasury asset for another via a direct
CPI into the Jupiter v6 aggregator, signing as the `vault_authority` PDA.
The route is built off-chain and forwarded as `route_data` +
`remaining_accounts`. Mainnet-only (Jupiter v6 is mainnet-deployed).

accounts.name: mint_in
docs: Asset being sold.

accounts.name: mint_out
docs: Asset being acquired.

accounts.name: source_token_account
docs: Vault-owned holding account for `mint_in` (the `asset_vault` PDA bound to
`treasury_asset_in.token_account`). Swap source.

accounts.name: destination_token_account
docs: Vault-owned holding account for `mint_out` (the `asset_vault` PDA bound to
`treasury_asset_out.token_account`). Swap destination.

accounts.name: jupiter_program
docs: the route accounts forwarded as `remaining_accounts`.

instructions.name: jupiter_withdraw
docs: Operational-agent-gated: redeem `amount` underlying base units (or
`u64::MAX` for the full position) from the Jupiter Lend Earn vault back
into the vault-owned underlying ATA.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Underlying asset mint being redeemed.

accounts.name: f_token_mint
docs: jlToken (fToken) mint burned on redemption.

accounts.name: owner_token_account
docs: Vault-owned jlToken ATA (withdraw source, burned).

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: Vault-owned underlying ATA (withdraw destination).

instructions.name: kamino_deposit
docs: Operational-agent-gated: deploy escrowed liquidity into the configured
Kamino reserve, receiving cTokens into the vault-owned position account.

instructions.name: kamino_withdraw
docs: Operational-agent-gated: redeem cTokens from the configured Kamino reserve
back into the position escrow as the underlying liquidity.

instructions.name: marginfi_deposit
docs: Operational-agent-gated: deploy escrowed liquidity into the configured
MarginFi bank via a real `lending_account_deposit` CPI.

accounts.name: marginfi_account
docs: non-PDA ledger address recorded at `configure_marginfi_position` time).

instructions.name: marginfi_withdraw
docs: Operational-agent-gated: redeem liquidity from the configured MarginFi
bank back into the position escrow via a real `lending_account_withdraw`
CPI. `remaining_accounts` must forward the bank's oracle account(s) for
MarginFi's post-withdrawal health check.

accounts.name: bank_liquidity_vault_authority
docs: `mut` here (even though it is a PDA authority, not a balance-holding
account) matches the writable requirement empirically observed on the
deployed devnet program — see the CPI-side comment in the handler.

instructions.name: mint_dao_token
docs: CPI-only from `nave_governance::mint_additional_tokens` (verified via
the instructions sysvar): PDA-signed mint of a registered DAO token.
The DAO-registry PDA (mint authority) belongs to this program, so only
nave_core can `invoke_signed` for it.

accounts.name: instructions_sysvar
docs: `nave_governance::mint_additional_tokens`).

instructions.name: nullify_agent
docs: SOL-H2: guardian M-of-N (not a single Executive) nullifies an agent slot
and freezes the DAO. `action_nonce` keys the accumulating GuardianAction.

instructions.name: record_bootstrap_usage
docs: Consume the DAO's one-time founder bootstrap latch. CPI-only from
`nave_execution` (see `record_bootstrap_usage_handler`).

accounts.name: founder
docs: The DAO founder. Must sign (the signature propagates from the founder's
`create_execution_request` call through the nave_execution CPI) and must
match the registry founder.

accounts.name: instructions
docs: this instruction is executing as a CPI from nave_execution.

instructions.name: record_moonlight_request
docs: Record an approved `MoonlightRequest`: halt agents + block new
strategy/deposit, recording the proposal creator as distribution driver.

accounts.name: agent_set
docs: The DAO's agent set: `agents_enabled` here is the flag every agent gate
reads, so the moonlight halt must flip it (not only the registry mirror).

accounts.name: instructions
docs: the top-level instruction caller — verified in the handler via `verify_governance_caller`).

accounts.name: mint
docs: Asset mint funding this deployment; keys the per-asset accounts below.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Asset mint being unwound; keys the per-asset accounts below.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Fee configuration. The skim rate is the canonical 1500 bps,
not the stored value. Writable so a stale rate is corrected.
`protocol_revenue_wallet` is the skim destination.

accounts.name: revenue_token_account
docs: Destination for the performance-fee skim: a token account owned by the
configured protocol revenue wallet, for the withdrawn mint.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Vault ATA receiving optional `initial_supply` (must match `mint`).

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable for the optional `initial_supply` mint_to.

instructions.name: register_nft_asset
docs: Register an NFT (decimals-0, supply-1 SPL mint) for treasury custody.
Creates the NftVaultRecord + vault-owned holding account; held at $0 NAV.

instructions.name: resize_guardian_config
docs: Permissionless one-byte layout migration for GuardianConfig accounts
created before the `bootstrapped` latch field existed.

instructions.name: restore_dao
docs: Founder-only reopen. Does not lock new NAVE. `amount` and
`price_usd_micro` stay in the signature and are ignored. Pass the
nave_core program id for the optional stake accounts when this
treasury never created a DaoStakeLock. An existing lock stays released.

instructions.name: set_max_single_swap_bps
docs: Founder-gated: set the per-DAO `jupiter_swap` max single-call size
guardrail (bps of the pre-swap balance of the asset sold). `0`
disables it (default).

instructions.name: set_max_slippage_bps
docs: Founder-gated: set the per-DAO `jupiter_swap` max-slippage guardrail
(bps). `0` disables it (default).

instructions.name: set_moonlight_distribution
docs: Distribution wizard step 1: the proposal creator enters the recipient.

instructions.name: set_nave_mint
docs: Admin-only: pin/rotate the canonical NAVE creation-stake mint (devnet
replica / mainnet real mint). Stored in the global-config bytes that were
previously `reserved` (layout unchanged).

instructions.name: stake_dao_creation
docs: Optional legacy lock of recoverable NAVE into escrow. New treasuries
are not required to call this after init. The instruction still locks
when invoked, so an existing lock can later be released by moonlight.
`amount` must meet the minimum; the handler enforces a full receipt.
Formation itself charges NO protocol fee. `price_usd_micro` is
price-snapshot metadata only.

instructions.name: switch_voting_system
docs: SOL-C2: CPI-only from `nave_governance::execute_switch_voting_system`
(verified via the instructions sysvar). The target governance
configuration is decoded from the passed, Passed+finalized
`SwitchVotingSystem` proposal's payload, not a caller-supplied
argument — see `switch_voting_system_handler` for the full rationale.

accounts.name: instructions_sysvar
docs: instruction is CPI-only from `nave_governance`).

accounts.name: proposal
docs: against `dao_registry`, proposal type, status, and payload hash).

accounts.name: dao_control
docs: (never guardian-locked). Decoded by `DaoControl::is_guardian_locked`.

instructions.name: update_guardian_config
docs: Founder one-shot ActivationHub bootstrap. After `GuardianConfig.bootstrapped`
is true, further changes require `apply_guardian_config_from_governance`
via a passed Permission proposal.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Asset mint of the position being marked; keys the position PDA.

accounts.name: strategy_escrow
docs: Escrowed principal not yet supplied to the venue.

accounts.name: venue_state
docs: key, owner and embedded mints are verified in the handler.

accounts.name: receipt_token_account
docs: in the handler.

types.name: AgentSet
docs: Fixed four-role agent set for a DAO.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: dao
docs: Owning DAO registry key.

fields.name: agents
docs: Exactly four agent roles.

fields.name: agents_enabled
docs: Global agent enable flag.

fields.name: pending_rotations
docs: Pending rotations per agent role.

types.name: AgentSlot
docs: Individual agent slot within a DAO agent set.

fields.name: role
docs: Agent role discriminator.

fields.name: authority
docs: Agent authority pubkey.

fields.name: active
docs: Whether the agent is active.

fields.name: nullified
docs: Whether the agent has been nullified.

fields.name: status
docs: Operational status (0=Active, 1=Paused, 2=Revoked, 3=Rotating).

types.name: AssetConfig
docs: Per-(dao, mint) configuration for a treasury-eligible asset. Governs how the
asset is valued in USD on-chain (Pyth feed + decimals) and how the agent
pipeline is allowed to route it (asset_kind). Distinct from `TokenRegistry`,
which tracks tokens the DAO itself *issues* rather than *holds*.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: dao
docs: Owning DAO registry key.

fields.name: mint
docs: SPL mint of the held asset.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Mint decimals (cached for valuation math).

fields.name: pyth_feed_id
docs: Pyth price-feed id (32-byte feed id, NOT a price account address). Used
with `get_price_no_older_than` to value the asset in USD. May be all
zeroes for stablecoins valued at a hard $1.

fields.name: is_stablecoin
docs: Whether the asset is a USD-pegged stablecoin valued at exactly $1.

fields.name: asset_kind
docs: `AssetKind` discriminant for protocol routing.

fields.name: enabled
docs: Whether the asset is currently enabled for deposits/deployment.

types.name: DaoBootstrapUsed
docs: Emitted when the DAO's one-time founder bootstrap latch is consumed (via the
nave_execution CPI). Lets off-chain indexers detect that the zero-review
-window bootstrap path has been used for this DAO.

types.name: DaoControl
docs: Per-DAO agent-safety state. Companion PDA to `DaoRegistry`/`AgentSet`
(seeds `["dao_control", dao]`), created lazily so existing account layouts
stay frozen across the program upgrade. A missing account reads as default.

fields.name: guardian_locked
docs: Set by a guardian-quorum `guardian_disable_agents`; cleared only by
`guardian_enable_agents`. While set, `toggle_agents(true)` reverts.

fields.name: pending_review_window_secs
docs: Queued review-window reduction (0 = none).

types.name: DaoLifecycle
docs: Per-DAO moonlighting lifecycle. Companion PDA to `DaoRegistry`
(seeds `["dao_lifecycle", dao]`), created on first moonlight action so the
registry byte layout stays frozen for existing decoders/IDL clients.
Phases (see `MoonlightStatus`):
- `Requested`: an approved `MoonlightRequest` proposal halts the agents and
blocks new strategy/deposit while controlled unwind/distribution runs.
- `DistributionPending`: the proposal creator entered the recipient wallet
and bound a second `MoonlightDistribution` proposal.
- `Distributing`: the distribution proposal passed; assets (SOL/SPL/NFT via
the existing governance transfer instructions) and the staked NAVE are
released to the recipient.
- `Moonlighted`: distribution complete; the DAO is hidden from participants
and can be restored by the founder without locking new NAVE.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: dao
docs: Owning DAO registry key.

fields.name: status
docs: Moonlight state machine value (see `MoonlightStatus`).

fields.name: request_proposal
docs: Passed `MoonlightRequest` proposal that opened the request phase.

fields.name: distribution_proposal
docs: Passed `MoonlightDistribution` proposal binding the recipient + payout.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Approved recipient wallet for the asset + stake distribution.

fields.name: initiated_by
docs: Proposal creator who is authorized to drive the distribution wizard.

fields.name: requested_at
docs: Unix timestamp the moonlight request was recorded.

fields.name: distributed_at
docs: Unix timestamp distribution was executed (stake released).

fields.name: moonlighted_at
docs: Unix timestamp the DAO was marked moonlighted/hidden.

fields.name: restored_at
docs: Unix timestamp the founder restored the DAO (no new stake).

fields.name: reserved
docs: EXTENSION POINT (stub — do NOT implement yet): future governance
voting-weight = staked-amount accounting. Reserved bytes are kept zeroed
so the concept can be layered on without a layout migration. See the
plan's "Stub the future voting-weight = staked-amount concept".

types.name: DaoRegistry
docs: Per-DAO registry and lifecycle state.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: dao_id
docs: Monotonic DAO identifier.

fields.name: founder
docs: DAO founder authority.

fields.name: name
docs: Fixed-size DAO name bytes.

fields.name: name_len
docs: Active name length.

fields.name: privacy_mode
docs: Privacy mode (see PrivacyMode enum).

fields.name: frozen
docs: Emergency freeze flag.

fields.name: agents_enabled
docs: Whether agent approvals are enabled.

fields.name: proposal_count
docs: Active proposal counter (governance-linked). Incremented on creation and
DECREMENTED by `archive_proposals`; used only for the
`MAX_PROPOSALS_PER_DAO` active-limit enforcement, never as a PDA seed.

fields.name: archived_proposals
docs: Cumulative archived proposals.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp of creation.

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Unix timestamp of last update.

fields.name: quorum_bps
docs: Minimum participation for proposal passage (basis points of snapshot supply).

fields.name: governance_type
docs: Active governance/voting model (see GovernanceType enum: 0 = Wallet, 1 = Token).

fields.name: voting_token
docs: Designated voting token mint when governance_type == Token (default when none).

fields.name: next_proposal_index
docs: Monotonic proposal index. Only ever INCREMENTS (on proposal creation);
`archive_proposals` never touches it. Used as the per-proposal PDA seed
(`PROPOSAL_SEED`) and `proposal_index` so an archived slot's index can
never be reused — which previously caused a PDA `init` collision because
the seed was derived from the decremented `proposal_count`.

fields.name: bootstrap_used
docs: One-time founder bootstrap latch. `false` at creation; flipped to `true`
the first time the founder creates a bootstrap execution request (which
snapshots `review_window = 0` for immediate execution). Once set it can
never be reset, so the zero-review-window path is available exactly once
per DAO. Mutated only by `record_bootstrap_usage` (CPI from
`nave_execution`). Appended at the END of the layout to preserve the byte
offsets consumed by off-chain decoders / IDL clients.

types.name: DaoStakeLock
docs: Per-DAO recoverable creation stake. Companion PDA to `DaoRegistry`
(seeds `["dao_stake_lock", dao]`) so the registry byte layout consumed by
off-chain decoders / IDL clients is untouched. New treasuries do not
create this account. When it exists, it bookkeeps NAVE held in the
dedicated `stake_escrow` token account whose authority is this PDA.
Formation takes NO protocol profit: an existing lock is fully
recoverable and is released to the approved recipient during an
approved moonlight distribution (see `DaoLifecycle`).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: dao
docs: Owning DAO registry key.

fields.name: founder
docs: Founder who locked the stake.

fields.name: nave_mint
docs: NAVE mint the stake is denominated in (matches `global_config.nave_mint`
when pinned).

fields.name: escrow_token_account
docs: Escrow token account (authority = this PDA) holding the locked NAVE.

fields.name: locked_amount
docs: Currently locked NAVE base units.

fields.name: price_usd_micro
docs: Accepted oracle NAVE/USD price at stake time, in micro-USD (e.g. devnet
fixed $10 ⇒ 10_000_000). `0` when no price was supplied.

fields.name: stake_value_usd_micro
docs: Target stake USD value at lock time, micro-USD (`$99` ⇒ 99_000_000).

fields.name: status
docs: Lifecycle of the stake (see `StakeStatus`).

fields.name: unlock_eligible
docs: Whether the stake is eligible to be released (set when an approved
moonlight distribution authorizes the payout to the recipient).

fields.name: locked_at
docs: Unix timestamp the stake was (re)locked.

fields.name: released_at
docs: Unix timestamp the stake was released (0 while locked).

types.name: DaoStakeLocked
docs: Emitted when a founder locks (or re-locks, on restore) the recoverable NAVE
creation stake into escrow. Indexers use this to display the recoverable
stake separately from protocol fees (there is none at formation).

types.name: DaoStakeReleased
docs: Emitted when the staked NAVE is released out of escrow to a recipient (the
approved moonlight recipient) or back to the founder on wind-down.

types.name: FeeConfig
docs: Fee configuration with normal and frozen rates.
Yield-only fee model:
- Performance fee = 1500 bps (15%) of realized yield, skimmed on
`record_strategy_withdrawal` into the `protocol_revenue_wallet` ATA.
Frozen treasuries use the same rate. A stale stored value is corrected
on that path.
- Management fee = 0. `collect_management_fee` transfers nothing and
does not advance the annual anchor. The field is retained so the
account layout does not move.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: dao
docs: Owning DAO registry key.

fields.name: management_fee_bps
docs: Management fee in basis points (default `DEFAULT_MANAGEMENT_FEE_BPS`, 65).

fields.name: performance_fee_bps
docs: Performance fee in basis points (default `DEFAULT_PERFORMANCE_FEE_BPS`,
850). Applied to realized yield on withdrawal.

fields.name: frozen_management_fee_bps
docs: Frozen-state management fee in basis points.

fields.name: frozen_performance_fee_bps
docs: Frozen-state performance fee in basis points.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: LEGACY (pre-redesign): SPL token account that the old USD-denominated
`collect_*_fee` paths paid into. Retained for account-layout stability;
the new model pays to the `protocol_revenue_wallet`'s ATA per mint
instead. No longer read by the fee instructions.

fields.name: fee_asset_mint
docs: LEGACY (pre-redesign): mint of the stablecoin USD-denominated fees were
paid in. Retained for layout stability; unused by the in-kind fee model.

fields.name: protocol_revenue_wallet
docs: Protocol revenue wallet (the SYSTEM/owner account, NOT a token account).
Destination for BOTH the performance-fee skim and the annual management
fee: each fee is paid to this wallet's associated token account for the
relevant mint. Also funds off-chain agent-wallet replenishment (consumed
by the off-chain worker). Must be set at DAO creation.

`amount_out` are the ACTUAL base-unit deltas observed on the vault token
accounts (not the requested figures). A `revalue_treasury` should follow to
reprice NAV, since the swap mutates per-asset accounting without recomputing
the portfolio aggregate.

stake instruction accepts any mint until `set_nave_mint` pins it.

types.name: NftVaultRecord
docs: Per-(dao, nft_mint) custody record for a treasury-held NFT.
NFTs are held in a dedicated `nft_vault` token account owned by the DAO's
`vault_authority` PDA. Unlike fungible `TreasuryAsset`s, NFTs are NOT priced
(no Pyth feed) and do NOT count against the fungible asset cap — they are
custodied at $0 NAV and leave only through a passed governance Transfer
proposal (`execute_governance_transfer_nft`).

fields.name: dao

fields.name: mint

fields.name: token_account
docs: The `nft_vault` holding token account (owned by vault_authority).

fields.name: transferred
docs: True once the NFT has been transferred out via governance. A transferred
record is retained for audit but blocks a second governance transfer.

types.name: TreasuryAsset
docs: Per-(dao, mint) treasury accounting record. Each held asset has its own
holding token account (the `asset_vault` PDA owned by `vault_authority`) and
tracks principal in that asset's base units. Portfolio-level USD aggregates
live on `TreasuryVault`; this record holds the raw token figures that the
`revalue_treasury` instruction prices into USD.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: dao
docs: Owning DAO registry key.

fields.name: mint
docs: SPL mint of the held asset.

fields.name: token_account
docs: The `asset_vault` holding token account (owned by vault_authority).

fields.name: deposited
docs: Cumulative deposits in base units.

fields.name: deployed_capital
docs: Capital currently deployed to strategies in base units (sum across
protocols for this mint).

fields.name: last_valued_usd
docs: USD micro-units value of this asset (idle + deployed) at the last
`revalue_treasury`. Diagnostic / reconciliation aid.

fields.name: last_valued_at
docs: Timestamp of the last valuation.

fields.name: last_management_fee_at
docs: Accounting anchor for the discrete annual management fee, floored to a
midnight-UTC boundary. The fee becomes due when
`now >= last_management_fee_at + SECONDS_PER_YEAR`; on collection this is
advanced to `floor_to_utc_midnight(now)`. Seeded at asset registration so
the first period is anchored to (the UTC midnight of) registration time.
Per-asset (not vault-level) so each asset's annual cycle is independent.

types.name: TreasuryConstitution
docs: Treasury constitution defining approved DeFi protocols.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: dao
docs: Owning DAO registry key.

fields.name: protocol_count
docs: Active protocol count.

fields.name: protocols
docs: Fixed-size protocol entries.

fields.name: confidence_threshold
docs: Minimum Claude reasoning confidence (0-100) an agent must report
before the off-chain agent service will proceed with signing.

fields.name: review_window_secs
docs: Mandatory on-chain review window (seconds) between Oversight approval
(InReview) and `execute_strategy`. Governance-controlled per DAO so the
human-oversight delay can be tuned (production default 24h); snapshotted
onto each ExecutionRequest at creation so it cannot change mid-flight.

fields.name: min_stablecoin_reserve_bps
docs: Continuous treasury policy: minimum portfolio share (bps) that must be
held as stablecoin reserve at all times. `0` means unset (legacy
accounts) and disables the floor. Enforced off-chain by the deterministic
guardrails because the single-mint vault accounting cannot prove
multi-asset composition on-chain yet (multi-asset treasury milestone).
Appended at the end of the layout to preserve existing byte offsets.

fields.name: max_total_deployed_bps
docs: Continuous treasury policy: maximum portfolio share (bps) that may be
deployed across all approved strategies combined. `0` means unset and
disables the explicit global cap (per-protocol caps still apply).
Enforced on-chain at request creation and execution against vault NAV.

fields.name: min_liquidity_bps
docs: Continuous treasury policy: minimum portfolio share (bps) that must
remain immediately liquid (not deployed). `0` means unset and disables
the floor. Enforced on-chain against vault NAV.

fields.name: rebalance_frequency_secs
docs: Continuous treasury policy: rebalance cadence in seconds — how often the
agents exit positions, realize profit, and re-establish allocations.
`0` means unset (no cadence). Used by the off-chain policy loop to gate
rebalance-due eligibility.

fields.name: last_rebalance_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the last completed rebalance cycle. Maintained by the
agent pipeline; combined with `rebalance_frequency_secs` to determine
when the next rebalance is due. `0` until the first rebalance.

fields.name: agent_threshold_usd
docs: Minimum treasury NAV in micro-USD (USD_SCALE=1e6) required before agents
may deploy/swap. Compared against treasury_vault.current_nav. 0 disables
the gate.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
docs: Maximum allowed slippage (bps) for `jupiter_swap`, enforced against the
caller-supplied `expected_amount_out` in addition to the actual
`min_amount_out` floor already checked against realized output. `0`
means unset and disables this additional guardrail (the swap still
enforces the caller-supplied `min_amount_out`, unchanged). Founder-set
via `set_max_slippage_bps`. Appended at the end to preserve existing
byte offsets.

fields.name: max_single_swap_bps
docs: Maximum single `jupiter_swap` call size, in bps of the pre-swap balance
of the asset being sold (`mint_in`). `jupiter_swap` is Operational-agent
gated with no prior multi-agent-approval/review-window step (unlike
deposits into Kamino/Jito/MarginFi, which can only move funds already
escrowed via a governance-approved `execute_strategy`) — this is the
on-chain backstop bounding how much of a single asset one Operational
agent signature can move in one call. `0` means unset and disables the
cap (existing DAOs are unaffected until the founder opts in via
`set_max_single_swap_bps`). Appended at the end to preserve existing
byte offsets.

types.name: TreasuryVault
docs: Portfolio-level treasury accounting. With the multi-asset redesign the
USD-denominated aggregates (`current_nav`, `high_water_mark`,
`deployed_capital`, `total_deposited`, `total_withdrawn`) are stored in
micro-USD (`USD_SCALE` = 1e6) and recomputed by `revalue_treasury` from each
per-mint `TreasuryAsset` priced via Pyth. The legacy single-mint
`vault_token_account` is retained only for migration of pre-multi-asset DAOs
and is otherwise unused once `asset_count > 0`.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: dao
docs: Owning DAO registry key.

fields.name: vault_token_account
docs: Legacy single-mint vault token account (migration only).

fields.name: total_deposited
docs: Cumulative deposits in micro-USD.

fields.name: total_withdrawn
docs: Cumulative withdrawals in micro-USD.

fields.name: current_nav
docs: Current portfolio net asset value in micro-USD (idle + deployed).

fields.name: high_water_mark
docs: High-water mark for performance fees, in micro-USD.

fields.name: last_management_fee_at
docs: Last management fee collection timestamp.

fields.name: last_performance_fee_at
docs: Last performance fee collection timestamp.

fields.name: deployed_capital
docs: Capital currently deployed to strategy positions, in micro-USD.

fields.name: asset_count
docs: Number of registered treasury assets (`TreasuryAsset` records).

fields.name: last_revalued_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the last `revalue_treasury`. `0` means NAV has never
been computed. Executable strategy deploys hard-block when this is `0`
or older than the configured staleness window, so the USD-denominated
allocation / deployment / reserve caps are always enforced against a
fresh NAV rather than a stale snapshot.
